summary: Sunday kimbap at the parents' (Dad claims he made it; Mom: 'just the rice'). Mom slips into 반말 and Ethan asks her to talk casually. They explain 축의금: Japan does it too, and Korean families give money even at American weddings; about $100 from a friend, more from family; the name matters more than the money (Junsu once forgot his, so Mom couldn't tell who gave it). Ethan and Seoyun will give one envelope together; 준수 will give the least. Dad quietly asks Ethan to come by: there's something to do together.

paragraphs.ko: 일요일 오후, 이선은 서윤이와 같이 다시 서윤이 부모님 집에 갔다. 어머니가 김밥을 만든다고 했다.
paragraphs.en: On Sunday afternoon, Ethan went back to Seoyun's parents' house with her. Her mother had said she was making kimbap.

paragraphs.ko: 어머니: 이선 씨, 왔어? 아, 왔어요?
paragraphs.en: Mother: Ethan, you're here? Oh, I mean, you're here?

paragraphs.ko: 이선이 웃었다.
paragraphs.en: Ethan laughed.

paragraphs.ko: 이선: 저한테는 말 편하게 하세요.
paragraphs.en: Ethan: Please just talk to me casually.

paragraphs.ko: 어머니: 그래? 그럼 편하게 할게. 빨리 앉아. 배고프지?
paragraphs.en: Mother: Yeah? Then I'll talk casually. Sit down, quick. You must be hungry.

paragraphs.ko: 김밥이 산처럼 많았다.
paragraphs.en: There was a mountain of kimbap.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 이선 씨, 이 김밥은 내가 만들었어요.
paragraphs.en: Father: Ethan, I made this kimbap.

paragraphs.ko: 어머니: 당신은 밥만 했잖아.
paragraphs.en: Mother: All you did was the rice.

paragraphs.ko: 김밥 옆에 봉투가 몇 개 있었다.
paragraphs.en: Next to the kimbap were a few envelopes.

paragraphs.ko: 이선: 이건 뭐예요?
paragraphs.en: Ethan: What are these?

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: 축의금이야. 여기에 돈을 넣어서 줘.
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: Wedding gift money. You put money in here and give it.

paragraphs.ko: 이선: 아, 일본도 그래요! 근데 미국 결혼식에서도 줘요?
paragraphs.en: Ethan: Oh, Japan does that too! But do you give money at American weddings too?

paragraphs.ko: 어머니: 그럼. 우리는 선물보다 돈을 많이 줘. 받는 사람도 그게 편하고.
paragraphs.en: Mother: Of course. We give money more than presents. It's easier for the people getting it, too.

paragraphs.ko: 이선: 얼마나 넣어요?
paragraphs.en: Ethan: How much do you put in?

paragraphs.ko: 어머니: 친구는 보통 백 달러 정도. 가족은 그거보다 더 많이 하고.
paragraphs.en: Mother: Friends usually give about a hundred dollars. Family gives more than that.

paragraphs.ko: 이선: 그럼 저는?
paragraphs.en: Ethan: Then what about me?

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: 너는 나랑 같이 하나만 하면 돼.
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: You and I just do one together.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 돈보다 이름이 더 중요해요.
paragraphs.en: Father: The name matters more than the money.

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: 아빠 말이 맞아. 전에 준수가 봉투에 이름을 안 써서, 엄마가 누가 줬는지 몰랐어.
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: Dad's right. Once Junsu didn't write his name on the envelope, so Mom couldn't tell who it was from.

paragraphs.ko: 그때 준수가 방에서 나왔다.
paragraphs.en: Just then Junsu came out of his room.

paragraphs.ko: 어머니: 준수야, 지금 일어났어? 벌써 오후 두 시야.
paragraphs.en: Mother: Junsu, did you just get up? It's already two in the afternoon.

paragraphs.ko: 준수: 형, 축의금은 내가 제일 조금 할 거야. 난 학생이잖아.
paragraphs.en: Junsu: Hyung, I'll be giving the least. I'm a student, you know.

paragraphs.ko: 이선: 나도 돈 많이 없어.
paragraphs.en: Ethan: I don't have much money either.

paragraphs.ko: 준수: 형은 일하잖아. 나는 진짜 없어.
paragraphs.en: Junsu: You work, though. I really don't have any.

paragraphs.ko: 이선은 하나를 받아서 한국어로 이름을 썼다.
paragraphs.en: Ethan took one and wrote his name in Korean.

paragraphs.ko: 어머니: 서윤아, 이선 씨 이름 좀 봐!
paragraphs.en: Mother: Seoyun, look at Ethan's name!

paragraphs.ko: 집에 가기 전에 아버지가 이선에게 말했다.
paragraphs.en: Before Ethan went home, Father said to him,

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 다음에 시간 있으면 와요. 같이 할 일이 있어요.
paragraphs.en: Father: Come by when you have time. There's something I want us to do together.

questions.prompt_en: About how much does a friend usually give?

questions.prompt_ko: 준수가 봉투에 이름을 안 써서 어떻게 됐어요?
questions.prompt_en: What happened because Junsu didn't write his name on the envelope?

questions.prompt_ko: "돈___ 이름이 더 중요해요." 빈칸에 뭐가 들어가요?
questions.prompt_en: "The name matters more ___ the money." What goes in the blank?
